"Thank you for agreeing to participate. Let's start generally: can you describe a time when you felt as though you were acting one way on the outside, but felt very differently on the inside?"

{
  "next_question": "Have you ever felt as though there were two very different sides to your personality, perhaps even with distinct motivations or desires?",
  "reflection": "The opening question is meant to gently encourage the subject to speak about dissonance between external behavior and internal feelings—a common entry point for discussing duality in personality.",
  "reasoning": "Because the objective is to understand dual personality dynamics, it makes sense to ask about moments of internal conflict or difference between outward actions and inner thoughts.",
  "memory_evidence": "No prior interviewer memories; this is the initial encounter with subject J/H."
}
